segments.text: Another Creta Electric price hike in June 2026 — ₹18.03 to ₹24.70 lakh. Half your parking is already Cretas.
The regular Creta: ₹10.91 to ₹20.11 lakh, twenty-seven variants, three engines. Every one ends up on school duty.
Autocar says the all-new Creta lands late 2026 — bigger, finally hybrid. Today's showroom car? Already old news.
My pick: S(O) 1.5 Petrol, ₹12.06 lakh — wireless charging, ventilated seats, six airbags. Pricier variants add shine, not substance.
Creta is the paneer butter masala of Indian SUVs. Every family agrees. Nobody remembers which one they had last.
Which car should get this treatment next? Comment below — and like, share, subscribe.
